subject.title: feat(control-ui): agent identity editor, Settings-homed Agents page, scalable chip switcher

question: Should Agents stop participating in customizable sidebar navigation for existing users, or should Settings placement be additive while preserving existing pins and access?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes a persisted user navigation surface, and source inspection cannot determine whether losing the former sidebar placement is an approved product decision.

options.title: Preserve Existing Pins
options.body: Make Settings the default home while retaining previously pinned Agents entries and a supported way to keep that customization.

options.title: Accept Navigation Reset
options.body: Explicitly approve dropping existing Agents pins and document the upgrade-visible navigation change before merge.

options.title: Split The Relocation
options.body: Land identity editing and switcher scaling separately while pausing the navigation relocation for a focused product decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve Existing Pins
recommendation.body: Make Settings the default home while retaining previously pinned Agents entries and a supported way to keep that customization.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest observed history across the Agents and Control UI navigation surfaces involved in the decision.
